__doc: DELIBERATE REPLACEMENTS FOR PHOTOGRAPH SLOTS, APPLIED AFTER EXTRACTION.
The plan is derived from the imports in the last commit, so it can only ever
describe the photography the site already had. A photograph the school sends
later has no import to be found, and a hand-edit to the plan is erased the
next time the extractor runs. This file is where a new photograph is recorded
instead: reviewable, kept in git, and merged over the plan on every run.
WARNING: THE DESCRIPTION IS NOT OPTIONAL. Replacing the picture and leaving
the old alt behind describes the wrong image, and no check on this project
can see that - the production diff compares rendered text and an alt is not
rendered text. Change them together or not at all.
'why' is required by the merge. A slot is only worth overriding when the new
photograph is a truer picture of what that slot already claims; anything else
is decoration, and decoration is how a school site ends up evidencing things

pHall.alt: The entrance to {schoolName} on Parent-Teacher Day, the Head Boy and Head Girl standing at the welcome board with parents arriving at the help desks beyond
pHall.why: The slot showed a Parents' Forum sitting. This is Parent-Teacher Day itself.

pPanel.alt: A class teacher at {schoolName} going through a student's record with both parents across the desk, the student sitting beside them
pPanel.why: The slot showed a Parents' Forum panel. This is the meeting the page is about.

pTiers.alt: A mother and father at {schoolName} completing a form with the class teacher, their child at the desk beside them and other parents waiting their turn
pTiers.why: The slot showed rows of seated parents at a forum. This is a junior-section meeting.

pSpeak.why: The slot showed a parent at a forum microphone, which is a different event.
